message.reasoning_content:
Careful: sort -u gave "apple\nApple" because locale is likely non-C locale (en_US.UTF-8) where sort is case-insensitive-ish/ignores case. Task says "按字典序（区分大小写）" - lexicographic order distinguishing case. Need LC_ALL=C sort to get byte order: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum.

Let me redo with LC_ALL=C sort -u. Also dedupe case-sensitively: LC_ALL=C sort -u keeps both Apple and apple as distinct. Good.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "LC_ALL=C sort -u < <(tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d') > out/words.txt
echo "=== words.txt ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== count ==="; wc -l < out/words.txt
echo "=== sum ==="; cat out/sum.txt"}
